description_en: Creates a default virtual private cloud (VPC)
description_zh: 创建一个默认的专有网络VPC
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-default-vpc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-cidr-block 2408:XXXX:346:b600::/56 --enable-ipv6 false --resource-group-id rg-acfmystnjq40000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDefaultVpc

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the default VPC.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
默认VPC所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IPv6 CIDR block of the default VPC.

This parameter is required when EnableIpv6 is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
默认VPC的IPv6网段。

当EnableIpv6取值为true时，需要输入该参数
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the IPv6 CIDR block. Valid values:

false (default): does not enable the IPv6 CIDR block.
true: enables the IPv6 CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启IPv6网段。取值：

false（默认值）：不开启。
true：开启
parameters.name: enable_ipv6

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The ID of the default VPC that is created

RouteTableId.description_en: The ID of the route table that the system automatically creates after the default VPC is created
RouteTableId.description_zh: 创建默认VPC后，系统自动创建的路由表的ID

VRouterId.description_en: The ID of the vRouter that the system automatically creates after the default VPC is created
VRouterId.description_zh: 创建默认VPC后，系统自动创建的路由器的ID

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the default VPC that is created
